newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: Swedish long debt yields closed slightly down on Tuesday in line with stronger foreign markets while the crown softened somewhat.
Market focus is entirly on the outcome of the FOMC meeting.
"It's clear that there will be a rate hike in the United States. The question is whether it will be by 25 basis points, as 90 percent of the market believes, or more," one dealer said.
"Now we have to look at the comments to see if Greenspan hints at a bigger cut. If he does, the market will be unsettled," he said.
As expected the Riksbank left its key repurchase rate unchanged at 4.10 percent.
Six-month T-bill rates were flat at 4.27 percent while the ten-year bond yields dropped two basis points to 7.40 percent, well below today's highs.
Dealers said they were squaring out their positions so they would not have large positions overnight.
The crown softed to 4.5260 against the mark compared to 4.5220 late on Monday.
